content: home-assistant-libs/python-nmap is a GitHub-only fork (not separately published to PyPI); PyPI's python-nmap (0.7.1) is the original unmaintained xael.org package. Install the fork via pip install 'python-nmap @ git+https://github.com/home-assistant-libs/python-nmap' to get the maintained fork under the same import name 'nmap'.
